title: TABLESTYLE DWG unit wire domain and generated identity vectors

authorities.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authorities.finding: §20.4.99 enumerates serialized DWG unit types 0=unitless, 1=distance, 2=angle, 4=area, and 8=volume. §20.4.101.3 points TABLESTYLE content unit type to that shared DWG value definition. §20.4.101.2 documents the R24 standard style IDs 1-4 and custom IDs starting at 101.

authorities.title: Autodesk AutoCAD DatabaseServices.UnitType Enumeration
authorities.finding: The API additionally defines Currency=0x10, Percentage=0x20, and AngleNotTransformed=0x10000. This API enumeration alone does not qualify these values as serialized DWG values in the TABLESTYLE field.

authorities.title: Existing local AC1024 TABLESTYLE producer receipt
authorities.finding: The physical architectural_example-imperial.dwg TABLESTYLE at handle 135 exposed repeated style ID 1 with raw class 0. Preserve class 0 as opaque compatibility state; do not assign it data/label meaning.

implementation.unitTypePolicy: DWG content-format and legacy-row readers now use the strict serialized-wire domain shared with DWG payload validation/output: versions AC1021+ and values 0, 1, 2, 4, 8. The broader API/DXF enum validator remains separate. Unsupported API-only values fail parsing atomically through the existing TABLESTYLE reset path.
implementation.identityControl: The generated repeated-style frame now writes the repeated style index equal to the repeated style ID, satisfying the existing parser relation. The prior generated value zero caused all repeated-style identity vectors to be rejected before ID/class retention could be checked.
implementation.compatibility: Class zero remains accepted only within the already established AC1024 repeated-style compatibility range and remains uninterpreted. This change does not broaden output qualification or support claims.

limits: Generated object vectors prove parser behavior for the specified values, not producer breadth.
No serialized DWG witness for the API-only unit values was found or claimed.
No native CAD semantic, graph-closure, or whole-file output qualification is added.
P5 and the overall DWG/DXF parity objective remain open.
